# Cubeon Launcher

> Cubeon Launcher is a free, GPL-3.0 open-source desktop launcher for Minecraft Java Edition on Windows and Linux. The official website is https://www.ylet.online/ and the official repository is https://github.com/Shadow-457/Cubeon.

## Product facts

- Also called Cubeon Minecraft Launcher. Cubeon is a separate project from the similarly named Cubion launcher.
- Manages Minecraft Java versions, instances, mods, modpacks, skins, cosmetics, friends and local servers.
- Built-in public tunnels and automatic internet world sharing are no longer supported. Local servers need separately configured network access for remote players.
- Supports Vanilla, Fabric, Quilt, Forge and NeoForge instances. Mods must match the Minecraft version and loader.
- Uses local/offline player profiles. Microsoft account sign-in is not available; servers requiring Microsoft authentication cannot accept these profiles.
- Does not launch Minecraft Bedrock Edition. Cubeon is an independent fan project, not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
- Windows distribution uses the Setup.exe installer. Linux offers an AppImage, setup installer and Debian/Ubuntu package. macOS is untested; downloads and updates are unavailable.
- The launcher is free. Minecraft requires compatible Java and graphics drivers. Source and bundled components retain their respective licenses.
- Available binaries and stable/beta status are listed on the download page and GitHub releases; check those sources for current versions.

## Official sources

- [Cubeon Bench](https://www.ylet.online/cubeon-bench): coming soon as a resource pack editor exclusively for Cubeon cosmetics.

- [Project facts](https://www.ylet.online/about): product identity, platforms, profiles and limitations.

- [Releases](https://github.com/Shadow-457/Cubeon/releases): current binaries, release notes and beta labels.
- [License](https://github.com/Shadow-457/Cubeon/blob/main/LICENSE): GNU General Public License v3.0 source license.
